environmentVariables.name: TOOL_PROFILE

environmentVariables.description: Bridge backend: local_bridge or experimental remote_relay

environmentVariables.name: CORS_ORIGIN

environmentVariables.description: Enable experimental raw EasyEDA runtime execution gate (dangerous; requires BRIDGE_RAW_EXEC_ENABLED)

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Port scan specification (comma-separated ports or ranges)
environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_PORT_SCAN

environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for EasyEDA Pro to become available on startup (ms)
environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_WAIT_FOR_EDA_MS

environmentVariables.description: Max bridge payload size in bytes
environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Enable raw method execution on bridge (dangerous)
environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_RAW_EXEC_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: AI provider (none, anthropic, openai, openrouter, local)
environmentVariables.name: AI_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: JWKS endpoint for token signature validation
environmentVariables.name: OAUTH_JWKS_URI
